ABOUT

            
Scour

            
A small, review-first cleaner for Windows, built on the Burrow engine.

          

        

        

          
Scour never deletes on its own. A scan produces a list, you choose from it, and Scour moves exactly that list to the Recycle Bin. The engine's own delete command is macOS-only, so Windows cleanup is handled here.
